name: Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3
blurb: NVIDIA’s high-throughput multilingual ASR — 25 European languages from a 600M-parameter FastConformer-TDT.
about: Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 is NVIDIA’s current multilingual FastConformer-TDT checkpoint: 25 European languages, automatic language detection, punctuation and capitalisation, plus word-level timestamps. It records 5.66% average cleaned WER at roughly 6,098× realtime in the current Open ASR Leaderboard evaluation.

The English-only v2 remains slightly better on that benchmark at 5.39%, while v3 is the stronger default for multilingual work. Both are CC-BY-4.0; v3 now loads through Transformers as well as NVIDIA NeMo, making deployment simpler than earlier Parakeet releases.
install:
pip install -U transformers torch torchaudio

python -c "
from transformers import pipeline
asr = pipeline('automatic-speech-recognition',
  model='nvidia/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3')
print(asr('audio.wav')['text'])"
